tasks.prompt: Under Section 2, who determines the purpose and means of processing personal data?
tasks.explanation: Section 2 defines the Data Fiduciary by reference to determining the purpose and means of processing personal data.

hints.text: Look at the statutory definition of Data Fiduciary.

tasks.prompt: Which section contains the general obligations of a Data Fiduciary?
tasks.explanation: Section 8 is titled General obligations of Data Fiduciary.

hints.text: Check the Act section dealing with general Data Fiduciary obligations.

tasks.prompt: Which right is specifically addressed by Section 14?
tasks.explanation: Section 14 is the right to nominate.

tasks.prompt: Which section establishes the Data Protection Board of India?
tasks.explanation: Section 18 provides for establishment of the Data Protection Board of India.

hints.text: Look at the chapter on the Board.

tasks.prompt: Which Rule specifies reasonable security safeguards?
tasks.explanation: Rule 6 is titled Reasonable security safeguards.

hints.text: Look for the Rule dealing with security safeguards.

tasks.prompt: Which Rules commenced on publication of the Gazette notification?
tasks.explanation: Rule 1(2) provides that Rules 1, 2 and 17 to 21 come into force on the date of publication in the Official Gazette.

tasks.prompt: Which section addresses Significant Data Fiduciaries?
tasks.explanation: Section 10 provides additional obligations of Significant Data Fiduciary.

hints.text: Look for the section specifically titled with Significant Data Fiduciary.
Check the enforcement chapter of the Act.

tasks.prompt: Which Rule addresses transfer of personal data outside the territory of India?
tasks.explanation: Rule 15 addresses transfer of personal data outside the territory of India.

hints.text: Check the Rules provision on transfers outside India.

tasks.prompt: Which section provides for the right to grievance redressal?
tasks.explanation: Section 13 provides for the right to grievance redressal.

hints.text: Check the sequence of Data Principal rights in Sections 11 to 14.
